name: Settings
descr: The settings the people of the shop change themselves - the window of the program calls them Settings. What a setting is and where it stands is declared by the developer in the registry, and the User settings tool keeps that; here only the value moves. A person changes a setting when the branch it stands on was given to them or to their group, and CmdList says of every setting whether this person may.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the settings this person may work with - code, name, description, entry mask, value. A branch nobody opened for them answers nothing at all, the way the window of the program shows nothing there.

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Writes the value of one setting, by its code. The engine weighs the right and takes the lock itself, so a refusal here says which of the three it was: no such setting, not this person's branch, or the table is in work.

params.name: code
params.descr: the code of the setting, the one a module reads it by - CmdList answers them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the value the setting keeps from now on; the mask of the setting is what the program enforces, not this tool
